about_the_game:
Welcome to Synthopolis, a strange, virtual city in a parallel world — guardian of a unique and coveted resource: the Color.

In this stylized chase FPS, you play as humanity’s champion in competitive 1v1 rounds lasting five minutes. The goal? Capture and hold the Color until time runs out to win the round… or hunt down your opponent relentlessly to take it back by force.

Slide, leap, and propel yourself with a grappling hook as you explore the heights and alleyways of a brutalist watercolor cityscape.

Use weapons and deception items to gain an advantage or turn the tide of the match. Reflexes, strategy, and anticipation will be your greatest allies.

In solo mode, train freely or attempt speedruns.
In multiplayer, face off in intense head-to-head matches.

Experience the game first-hand during the Steam Next Fest, with an exclusive look at the gameplay:

  • Competitive 1v1 multiplayer mode (Hunter vs. Color Carrier)

  • 1 playable map: the virtual city of Synthopolis

  • Dynamic movement and grappling system

  • Items to reveal or deceive your opponent’s position

  • Items to boost your firepower

  • Solo training mode

  • Stylized 3D / gray watercolor aesthetic with an immersive atmosphere

Will you hold the Color… or take it back?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Win 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 550 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 6770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2048 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible DirectX

short_description: Face off and claim the Color at all costs — the life-saving resource of humanity hidden in the mysterious city of Synthopolis. Outplay your opponent in this competitive and visually groundbreaking game.
